1→# COPs (Compositing) Node Reference
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→COPs = Composite Operators. Houdini's built-in 2D image compositing context.
     5→Located at `/img` or inside `cop2net` SOPs/LOPs.
     6→
     7→## Common COP Node Types
     8→
     9→### Generators
    10→| Node | Description |
    11→|------|-------------|
    12→| `file` | Load image/sequence from disk |
    13→| `color` | Solid color plane |
    14→| `ramp` | Gradient ramp (linear, radial, etc.) |
    15→| `noise` | Procedural noise pattern |
    16→| `font` | Text rendering |
    17→| `constant` | Constant value (all pixels same) |
    18→
    19→### Color Correction
    20→| Node | Description |
    21→|------|-------------|
    22→| `colorcorrect` | Gamma, gain, offset per channel |
    23→| `grade` | Lift/gamma/gain (film grading) |
    24→| `bright` | Simple brightness/contrast |
    25→| `hueshift` | Hue rotation |
    26→| `hsv` | HSV adjustment |
    27→| `lut` | LUT application |
    28→| `tonemap` | HDR tonemapping |
    29→
    30→### Compositing
    31→| Node | Description |
    32→|------|-------------|
    33→| `over` | A over B (alpha composite) |
    34→| `multiply` | Multiply blend |
    35→| `add` | Additive blend |
    36→| `subtract` | Subtractive blend |
    37→| `screen` | Screen blend |
    38→| `switch` | Switch between inputs |
    39→| `blend` | Blend with controllable mix |
    40→
    41→### Transform
    42→| Node | Description |
    43→|------|-------------|
    44→| `xform` | 2D translate/rotate/scale |
    45→| `crop` | Crop image bounds |
    46→| `scale` | Resize resolution |
    47→| `flip` | Flip horizontal/vertical |
    48→| `corner_pin` | Four-corner pin warp |
    49→
    50→### Filters
    51→| Node | Description |
    52→|------|-------------|
    53→| `blur` | Gaussian blur |
    54→| `defocus` | Lens defocus (bokeh) |
    55→| `sharpen` | Sharpen filter |
    56→| `edge` | Edge detection |
    57→| `median` | Median noise reduction |
    58→
    59→### Channels
    60→| Node | Description |
    61→|------|-------------|
    62→| `channelcopy` | Copy channels between planes |
    63→| `shuffle` | Rearrange channels |
    64→| `premultiply` | Premultiply alpha |
    65→| `unpremultiply` | Remove premultiplication |
    66→| `rename` | Rename image planes |
    67→
    68→### Output
    69→| Node | Description |
    70→|------|-------------|
    71→| `rop_comp` | Render/write to disk |
    72→| `null` | Output marker (like SOP null) |
    73→
    74→## Key Parameters
    75→
    76→### File COP
    77→- `filename` - Path to image/sequence (use `$F4` for frame padding)
    78→- `overridesize` - Override resolution
    79→- `linearize` - Apply sRGB to linear conversion
    80→
    81→### Color Correct
    82→- `gamma` / `gammar/g/b` - Per-channel gamma
    83→- `gain` / `gainr/g/b` - Per-channel gain
    84→- `offset` / `offsetr/g/b` - Per-channel offset
    85→- `saturation` - Saturation (1=unchanged)
    86→
    87→### Grade
    88→- `lift` - Shadow adjustment (lift)
    89→- `gamma` - Midtone adjustment
    90→- `gain` - Highlight adjustment
    91→- `whitepoint` / `blackpoint` - Range mapping
    92→
    93→## Tips
    94→- COPs process per-scanline (memory efficient for large images)
    95→- Use `null` nodes as output markers
    96→- Chain: `file` -> `colorcorrect` -> `grade` -> `null` for basic correction
    97→- COPs can be used inline in SOPs via `cop2net` for texture baking
